Safe 0xb9fe096da4b371fc0c8eceb5dacb6931e0748c43 on Ethereum Mainnet, nonce 497. Charter bafkreigg6ajqdb52kb644wcxegurt7r6jlclru4mjy3lwxkbh6avm3vgre. Disputed rule: R-4.5. Ruling: secure. The transaction approves 171505000000 USDT to Permit2 and the same through Permit2 to the UniversalRouter, which in the same MultiSendCallOnly batch makes two exact-input v4 swaps of 34301000000 and 137204000000 USDT, summing to the approved amount. Simulated at block 26277962, the swaps spend exactly that amount and leave both allowances at 0. The approval doesn't exceed what the interaction needs (§ 2.5), so it isn't functionally unlimited. Precedent 0x404a6460… is applied and distinguished: there the approval exceeded the amount used; here it doesn't.
